**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The Agreement imposes no non-solicitation or no-hire restriction on Corio. The only personnel-related terms are Commerce One's obligation to make its operations, consulting and engineering personnel available to Corio (§ 13.1–13.3), its warranty that its personnel have signed Employee NDA/Invention Agreements (§ 13.5), the independent-contractor disclaimer (§ 14.5), and each party's commitment to dedicate one sales/marketing employee under Exhibit D § 5 — none of which restricts soliciting, hiring or engaging the other party's staff. The integration clause forecloses any such covenant being imported from another document for this subject matter. No redline proposed.
